the tinymce editor iframe html background color should be (--instui-color-background-base) but it's currently getting `:where(html)` from pantoken base.css, we need to override it for this iframe. and also I think the light/dark switcher for the theme editor is not applying to the tinymce editor injected iframe, it stays in light mode regardless of the pantoken-color-scheme.
http://localhost:5173/tools/canvas-rce/

quotes.title: prompt to Copilot CLI, checkpoint 01M5162CGYJV7D0SSRG5VSGBWD

medium: The need to ensure inner elements maintain the same color, coupled with concerns about theme application and CSS inheritance, drove this line’s implementation.
note: Written with an AI agent; the prompts were recorded with Entire.

card.what: This line sets the `colorScheme` style property of the root element of the source document to 'light'.
card.why: Danny Wahl identified that the tinymce editor's injected iframe was defaulting to light mode, despite the theme settings in Pantoken being configured for a dark theme. The goal was to explicitly force the iframe's background color to 'light' to align with the theme and resolve a visual discrepancy [1][3]. This was part of a larger effort to correctly apply theme tokens to the tinymce editor's iframe [2].
card.next: Before making any changes, verify that the intention is still to force the iframe background to 'light' and that this aligns with the desired behavior of the theme switcher [3].
